content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Billboard, broadband and insurance businesses; no marketing agency work, so a different business from Stagwell."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Economic and litigation consulting for law firms and regulators, not marketing or communications services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Software measuring ad quality and fraud for advertisers; a verification technology provider rather than an agency network."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Software engineering and IT consulting for enterprises; no advertising, PR or marketing services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, failure analysis and forensic consulting; technical services with no marketing or communications overlap."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Healthcare, education and corporate consulting plus revenue cycle outsourcing; not marketing or advertising services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, construction and government infrastructure services; a project-based business unrelated to marketing."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Agency network offering advertising, media buying, PR and marketing services to large brands, matching Stagwell's core business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, healthcare and IT staffing supplying contract professionals; not an agency or marketing services business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Content recommendation and native ad technology platform sold to advertisers; a software-led ad tech business, not an agency network."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced customer support, content moderation and AI data work; operations outsourcing with no marketing agency services."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Programmatic ad buying software platform as primary product; technology-led rather than full-service agency work for brands."}]}
